ABS outlines simplified at 0.05 degrees. Mapshaper 0.6.113 repairs the NSW and ACT outlines, removes small errors, keeps 30% of outline points with keep-shapes, and saves TopoJSON map files. For display, not precise site measurements.

use: Sites with issued AM/FM licences, and digital-radio licence records at each site
notes: AM/FM/DR sheets; only records marked Issued, excluding Temporary Licences. Duplicate day/night records are removed using band, licence, technical specification and site ID, then grouped by site. GDA94 coordinates are converted from degrees/minutes/seconds to decimal degrees, including rounded 60-second entries. A licence does not prove a transmitter is operating, where its signal reaches or who listens. CC BY 2.5 AU.

dataset: National, state and territory population, March 2026: table 4
use: Circle areas show March 2026 population; colour shows digital inclusion based on 2024 data
notes: March 2026 population read directly from Table 4, Data1 in the Excel workbook. Estimates may be revised. All ages in the eight states and territories, excluding Other Territories. Size and colour describe different years. Population is not multiplied by the inclusion score to count people left out, and is not a count of media users. CC BY 4.0.
